note: What a SimForge Studio installer redistributes besides SimForge's own Apache-2.0 code, and what each item obliges us to do before that installer may be offered publicly. Every claim here is bound to bytes: `evidence[].sha256` values are the digests of files the build actually fetches (studio/desktop/tools.lock.json) or of the upstream metadata the claim is read from, and scripts/release/audit-bundled-licenses.mjs refuses to certify an installer whose lock no longer matches these pins. Obligation status is a recorded review outcome, never an assumption: `satisfied` means the artifact named in `evidence` exists, `unsatisfied` means the obligation is real and unmet, `undetermined` means nobody has established the answer. Anything other than `satisfied` blocks public redistribution of the affected targets.

components.role: ffmpeg and ffprobe, spawned as separate programs by the host to encode render output and to decode user-provided clips. Built for each target by studio/desktop/build-encoders.mjs from the sources pinned in studio/desktop/encoders.lock.json.

builtFromSource.why: Until 2026-09-07 the four packages carried three different third-party prebuilt static builds with three different licences, and the macOS arm64 one was configured --enable-nonfree, which FFmpeg states may not be redistributed at all. No upstream builder publishes corresponding source for those binaries either. Building from pinned source replaces four inherited provenances with one we control.
builtFromSource.closure: --disable-autodetect, so the only external library linked is libx264; FFmpeg's internal codecs stay at their defaults so user clips in H.264/HEVC/VP9/MJPEG/ProRes/AV1 can be decoded. --disable-network means a bundled encoder cannot be pointed at a URL.
builtFromSource.licenceOutcome: libx264 is GPL-2.0-or-later and FFmpeg is configured --enable-version3, so both executables are GPL-3.0-or-later on every platform. Identical outcome per target, unlike the prebuilt binaries.
builtFromSource.verification: Each build records the binary digests, the source commits and the corresponding-source archive digest in dist/desktop-tools/<target>/tools-manifest.json; readToolPins refuses a manifest whose source commits are not the ones the lock pins, and stage/after-pack/verify-package compare the staged, packaged and signed bytes against those digests.

obligations.requirement: Do not redistribute an ffmpeg configured --enable-nonfree.
obligations.evidence: The bundled encoders are built by studio/desktop/build-encoders.mjs from the pinned sources with the configure lines in studio/desktop/encoders.lock.json; --enable-nonfree is not among them and --disable-autodetect prevents a host library from adding one. No third-party prebuilt encoder is shipped.

obligations.requirement: The applicable licence text must accompany the binaries inside every package.
obligations.evidence: build-encoders.mjs writes dist/desktop-tools/<target>/LICENSE from the sources' own COPYING.GPLv3 and libx264 COPYING, naming both commits; stage.mjs copies it to the package's tools directory.

obligations.requirement: GPL-3.0 section 6 requires the complete corresponding source of these executables to accompany the distribution: both projects at the exact commits, plus the scripts controlling compilation and installation.
obligations.evidence: Each build writes corresponding-source/simforge-studio-encoders-<target>-corresponding-source.tar.gz containing git archives of both pinned commits, build-encoders.mjs, encoders.lock.json and a BUILD.md with the exact configure lines and toolchain versions. Publication attaches one archive per platform to the release and records its digest, and scripts/release/publish-desktop-release.mjs refuses to publish publicly without them, so no written offer is relied on.

Both are emitted by the generator's report, not counted by hand.
provenance.supersedes: 4f298a9fd7c8bbf8d19cc10f0a57ec4e5a9f955540c160e7985e335a8fad706f, identical except catalog-models.json: every walker entry now carries its measured grounding (groundOffsetM per bind pose and per clip, catalog/pedestrians-carla/tools/ground.py) instead of an asserted 0; no model bytes changed. That closure superseded 70dde8bb17ac3595d3e6c307dce8bf42f2d8fbcfb13bddd781f5cfe4daef18b4, identical except vehicle.bicycle and vehicle.motorcycle (now ridden: CARLA rider, odometer-phased clip, catalog rider contract) and their catalog-models.json entries; that closure superseded 6136ecbd9a486948f26b9e05f17c871f9b96a5c512db4be230e4b30cda82d192, which carried no CARLA vehicles at all.

classes.attribution: Per-model, from catalog/vehicles-carla/ATTRIBUTION.json and catalog/pedestrians-carla/ATTRIBUTION.json; each of the 68 entries carries its own string naming the model, the holder and CC BY 4.0. Example: "Ford Ambulance" vehicle model (c) CARLA Simulator contributors (carla.org), licensed CC BY 4.0; converted to glTF for SimForge. Pedestrians additionally credit the Computer Vision Center (CVC), Universitat Autonoma de Barcelona (UAB).

classes.content: 23 vehicle ids over 20 distinct GLBs, and 45 pedestrian ids (41 catalog walkers plus the four legacy pedestrian.adult/child _standing/_walking aliases, which answer the same members and were realigned off their old Meshy attribution) over 38 distinct skinned GLBs carrying in-model idle/walk/run clips.

classes.terms: Meshy ToS 3.2 (2026-03-07): free plan grants CC BY 4.0 with credit to Meshy; paid plan grants full ownership with no attribution. Either way redistribution is permitted; we credit under CC BY 4.0 to satisfy the stricter branch.
classes.attributionApplied: Model created with Meshy - CC BY 4.0 License
classes.content: Props, animals, street furniture and the specialist trucks (dump truck, tow truck, cement mixer, bucket truck) the CARLA pack does not cover. Down from 55: 16 ids moved to CARLA geometry and 4 legacy pedestrian aliases were realigned to it.

obligations.requirement: Reproduce each member's attribution, and for every CC BY 4.0 model its credit, license identification and the fact that it was converted.
obligations.evidence: The pinned catalog (sha256 7955d6ec...) carries a non-empty per-model attribution string for all 165 catalog entries, verified programmatically; all 68 carla-0.10.0-ue5 strings name the model, the rights holder and CC BY 4.0 and state that it was converted to glTF. THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES must reproduce the three provenance classes and the CARLA credit verbatim.

obligations.requirement: Establish the right to redistribute the 35 Meshy-generated models inside a publicly downloadable installer, and satisfy whatever that right requires.
obligations.evidence: Meshy Terms of Service (https://www.meshy.ai/terms-of-use, Last Updated 2026-03-07) section 3.2: free-plan customers acknowledge Meshy owns the output and are granted a licence "under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License (CC BY 4.0). This means Free Customer can share and adapt the assets for any purpose, even commercially, as long as Free Customer provides appropriate credit to Provider"; paid-plan customers retain ownership with no attribution requirement. Redistribution is therefore permitted under either plan, and the two branches differ only in whether credit is required. THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES credits Meshy under CC BY 4.0 unconditionally, which satisfies the stricter branch, so the plan question does not gate the release.
remediation: Optional: record the plan from the Meshy account billing history to drop the CC BY 4.0 credit requirement for these 35 models.
obligations.residualProvenanceGap: Which Meshy plan the closure was generated under is not recorded in this repository. The catalog generator (maintained in the SimCloud platform, not in this repository) drives Meshy's Text-to-3D API with a MESHY_API_KEY from the secrets manager, and the API is a subscription feature, which suggests a paid plan, but that is an inference. It is answerable only from the Meshy account's billing history, and it is not blocking: attributing under CC BY 4.0 is valid in both cases.

obligations.requirement: Serve the pinned closure document and its 162 blobs from the origin, so a packaged install can fetch them.
obligations.evidence: The closure document and all 162 distinct blobs are served by the origin under actor-assets/. Verified 2026-09-24 with `node packages/render/scripts/fetch-actor-closure.mjs --out <empty dir>` (no --from): all 168 members downloaded from https://da3tufozhdsvl.cloudfront.net and re-hashed against the pinned document.
remediation: None. Paths are content-addressed and immutable; a new closure is uploaded alongside, never over, an old one.
